LanguageData.LP_SerpentConstrictAbility.label: constrict
LanguageData.LP_SerpentConstrictAbility.description: Constrict an adjacent enemy for 3 seconds: it can't act and takes 6 blunt damage per second (×0.5 to ×2 by size ratio); you can't move meanwhile. Cooldown 12 hours.
LanguageData.LP_BladeStormAbility.label: blade storm
LanguageData.LP_BladeStormAbility.description: Against each enemy within 1 cell, the main hand and every usable off-hand attack once (guaranteed hit, resolved with real melee damage; off-hand damage uses the settings multiplier). Cooldown 2 days.
